input_order: per task k: xu, yu, xv, yv, x2, y2, each n planes with plane 0 first; input number = k*6n + field*n + plane
outputs: per task k: hit mask, exceptional mask (two wires each, in task order)
encoding: per op a tag byte (0 input,1 zero,2 ones,3 not,4 xor,5 and,6 or,7 xand=a^(b&c)) then u32 LE operands; 255 then the output wires as u32 LE
